name: Serving The Lord
overview: Serving the Lord is presented in Scripture as a deliberate and exclusive commitment, where believers must choose to serve God wholeheartedly rather than competing masters, as emphasized in Joshua 24:15 and Matthew 6:24. True service involves obedience to God's commandments and is not without cost or challenge, as Malachi 3:14 acknowledges the temptation to see service as vain. Christ exemplifies the heart of service by coming not to be served but to serve others sacrificially, offering His life as a ransom, as shown in Matthew 20:28 and Mark 10:45.
